protocol: tuned with time-series CV inside train; fitted on train; champion and threshold chosen on validation; test scored once

selection.rule: simplest supervised model that is non-inferior to the best on validation PR-AUC (paired bootstrap; upper 95% bound of the gap below the margin)
selection.reason: lightgbm has the highest validation PR-AUC (0.9878), but hist_gb (0.9820) is non-inferior: the 95% bootstrap interval of the gap is [+0.0032, +0.0084], entirely below the 0.01 margin. hist_gb is simpler, so it is selected.

imbalance_handling.isolation_forest: none needed: unsupervised, fitted on legitimate transactions only
